apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.6 — Two navigation/touch fixes. (1) LoopLab Edit: the stack is now owned as one path — the editor session is a plain path value, appended on Edit and removed on Done, so closing the editor returns to the song detail (build 50 popped to the songs list). (2) Waveform: the scroll gate now forwards touches over the still-visible part of the waveform at any scroll position, not only at rest.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
